field_evidence.dataset_title: Fires in London - cause of ignition is white goods
field_evidence.description: Fire incidents where the ignition source is recorded as white goods, with London borough and ward location plus appliance and property type.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the London Fire Brigade dataset 'Fires in London - cause of ignition is white goods'. It provides fire incidents by London borough and ward location, together with white-goods type and property type. The current published file covers January 2009 through July 2025, is updated annually, has Ward as the smallest geography, and is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution. This batch binds verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that official ward-level dataset without claiming extracted incident rows, geometry, parcel joins, or materialized parcel progress.
